title: Professional Experience
text:
Supply Chain Strategy & Data Analyst Intern / Working Student
Sindelfingen, Germany · October 2025 – Present

Cleaned, validated, aggregated, and analysed international CKD production-network data using Python, Pandas, Jupyter Notebook, and Excel Power Query.
Worked with data covering 8 countries, more than 10 plants, over 100 operational KPIs, and more than 10,000 KPI records per month.
Built and maintained a Power BI dashboard integrating country, plant, time-period, and KPI dimensions.
Improved management-reporting visibility and reduced manual consolidation effort.




Financial Controller
Hangzhou, China · September 2022 – April 2025

Led the design and launch of a Financial Shared Services System from requirements analysis and process modelling through UAT and production rollout.
Completed the implementation within one year, supporting more than 10,000 small-business clients.
Digitalised budgeting, approval, reimbursement, accounting, reconciliation, and management-reporting workflows.
Reduced manual entry and offline processing effort by more than 50%.
Used Excel VBA, Power Query, SQL, and Python for financial-data cleaning, budget forecasting, and business analysis.
Achieved more than 95% forecasting accuracy and reduced annual tax expenses by 20%.




Senior Financial Supervisor
Hangzhou, China · November 2019 – September 2022

Managed budgeting, financial reporting, business analysis, and compliance activities across multiple entities.
Used Excel, Power Query, and financial-analysis models for variance analysis, cost-structure analysis, and cash-flow monitoring.
Coordinated tax and compliance reporting with headquarters, business units, and external institutions.
Contributed to more than RMB 100 million in tax deferrals, improving cash-flow flexibility.

title: About Me
text:
I am a master’s student in Management and Digital Technology at the Technical University of Munich, Campus Heilbronn.
Before beginning my master’s degree, I built a strong professional foundation in financial controlling, business analysis, budgeting, compliance, and management reporting. I am currently expanding this experience through supply-chain strategy and data analytics work at Mercedes-Benz Group AG.
My main strength is the ability to connect business questions with analytical tools. I enjoy structuring complex information, identifying performance drivers, and turning data into clear recommendations for decision-makers.
